HYPER STRIKE
OBJECTIVE
Survive each wave, keep the kill chain alive, collect upgrades, and destroy the capital ship turrets during the flyover. When the Void Serpent arrives, break every segment of its tail — the moment the last one shatters you dive into the Core Breach: a chase-camera finish where you dodge the maw fire, shoot out its shield cores, then destroy the exposed head before the countdown ends. Bombs and Blast Charge work there too.
CONTROLS
WASD or arrows fly. Click and drag to move the ship. Space spends a nova bomb. Shift triggers Blast Charge when charged. P or Escape resumes.
THREATS
Interceptors chase, drones crowd the lane, bombers flood space with orbs, elites alternate aimed volleys and rings, capital turrets fire from the deck, and the serpent body rams.
PICKUPS
W
WEAPON
Guns + beam up
BOMB
Nova refill
SHARD
Blast Charge energy
Weapon cores raise firepower to level 5, then keep leveling the Blast Charge beam up to level 9. Getting hit drops weapon level by 1. Bomb cores refill nova bombs, and shards charge Blast Charge.
RESUME

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。
二次开发边界: 当前可确认的包级边界是所列静态 HTML、JavaScript 供应库和音频资源。若 index.html 中包含可读的应用代码，可在核实脚本结构后修改；目前不能确认这一点。
vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。
清单含多个名称或版本不同的 Three.js 文件。未检查加载顺序和模块依赖前，不应假定它们都被使用，也不应随意删除或替换。
所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

portable_modules.evidence: 清单列出多个 Three.js 文件；运行记录标注引擎为 three，且检测到一个 canvas。
portable_modules.portability: 可作为候选渲染依赖随静态包部署；实际使用的文件、版本和互相依赖关系尚未确认。

portable_modules.evidence: 清单列出对应脚本。
portable_modules.portability: 可作为候选模型加载与骨骼工具模块；清单未列出模型资源，实际是否使用以及所需模型路径未知。

portable_modules.evidence: 清单列出 14 个 WAV 文件，名称涵盖音乐、攻击、受击和效果音。
portable_modules.portability: 文件可随静态资源包携带；触发时机、音量混合、浏览器自动播放限制处理及关卡间管理均未验证。

portable_modules.evidence: 启动运行文本显示分数、生命、武器、炸弹、控制提示及启动、指南相关界面文字。
portable_modules.portability: 可确认这些文字在启动检查中出现，不能据此确认对应按钮、HUD 更新或交互逻辑可移植且正常工作。

dependencies: 包内依赖至少包括 index.html、所列 JavaScript 文件及 WAV 资源；记录中未观察到外部网络请求，但这只覆盖该次启动路径。
运行记录报告浏览器中创建了一个 canvas，并加载了字体；WebGL 在该次运行中可启动，但兼容性和其他设备表现未验证。
页面交互依赖 DOM；图形和声音分别依赖浏览器图形与音频能力。音频资源是否能在用户手势后正常播放尚未检查。
多个 Three.js 文件可能引入版本冲突、全局变量覆盖或重复加载风险；需要依据实际脚本引用和运行时模块图确认。
存储检查仅覆盖隔离页面中的 localStorage 和 sessionStorage，二者记录为空；IndexedDB 与内存状态未检查。
verification_limits: 检查记录报告运行通过、无错误、无缺失文件、无预加载错误，且启动界面已加载；这些是所给记录的结果，并非独立复测结论。
replay_action_count 为 0，actions 为空。鼠标或键盘移动、攻击、炸弹、爆破蓄力、暂停、关卡推进、首领战、受伤、结算及重开均未验证。
页面上显示的控制提示只证明提示文字出现，不证明相应输入有效。
仅有启动截图，未提供玩法过程截图、视频、操作日志、原作对照或行为断言；不能据此判断移植忠实度或完整度。
local-static-references 修改的哈希记录不等于源码差异审查；无法据此确认修改内容、兼容性或第三方库授权状态。
运行日志出现多条 GPU stall / ReadPixels 性能提示；其影响程度和是否由测试工具导致尚不清楚。
next_checks: 取得实际解包文件树、index.html 和相关脚本源码，核对资源路径、脚本加载顺序、实际使用的 Three.js 版本，并审查所列修改的源码差异。
在可重复的浏览器会话中记录真实输入与结果，至少检查启动、移动、攻击、炸弹、爆破蓄力、暂停与恢复、受伤、关卡推进、结算和重开；为每项定义可观察的通过条件。
保存带操作过程的截图或视频、浏览器控制台与网络记录，并将实际动作计数纳入验收材料；在获得玩法断言前，不标记玩法完整验收。
若原游戏设计包含进度保存，分别检查 localStorage、sessionStorage、IndexedDB 和重新载入后的状态；若不包含，记录该项不适用的依据。
在目标浏览器及不同窗口尺寸下复测 WebGL、字体、音频、输入和性能；确认 GPU stall 日志的影响。
复核静态包的文件清单、依赖来源、资源使用权和发布许可，再确定可发布范围。

ai_analysis.summary: 该交付物是一个基于 Cocos Creator 2.x（cocos2d-js-min）构建的标准 HTML5 网页游戏运行包。文件结构包含引擎运行时、入口脚本、settings、以及 internal/resources/main/home/game 等 Asset Bundle。资源类型涵盖 PNG/JPG、GIF、MP3/WAV、JSON 与 game bundle 下的一份 .bin。包内嵌入了第三方渠道 SDK（src/assets/syyx_sdk/syyxh5frameworksdk.bae2b.js），存在账号/支付/广告/数据统计等外部依赖。提供的文件清单末尾截断，且仅凭静态文件无法确认玩法完整性，不能视为可完整验收的移植产物。
ai_analysis.editable_logic: 二次开发边界（可在不破坏加载与校验关系的前提下修改）：1) style-mobile.css、启动页容器与页面样式；2) src/settings.618cd.js 中的启动场景、bundle 清单、渲染与适配参数；3) 各 Asset Bundle 的 config/index/import JSON（用于调整 UI 布局、预制体引用、资源 UUID 映射），但修改后必须保证 UUID 与 native 资源文件名一致；4) assets/resources 与 assets/home 下的图片、音频等可替换素材；5) assets/game 中的 .json 元数据可替换，.bin 内容语义未知，直接修改风险高；6) main.js 启动逻辑可注入补丁，但代码已压缩混淆，需先逆向。核心游戏逻辑位于编译后的 bundle JS 与 .bin 中，未提供源码时不能安全修改。
ai_analysis.portable_modules: 可直接迁移或复用的模块：1) cocos2d-js-min.4ceaa.js 引擎运行时（HTML5 通用）；2) internal/resources/main/home/game bundle 目录，只要保持相对路径与带 hash 的文件名不变；3) PNG/JPG/GIF/MP3/WAV 等资源文件；4) settings.js 与入口 HTML/JS 配置。限制：第三方 SDK（syyxh5frameworksdk）通常与原始域名、渠道签名或包名绑定，迁移到新环境大概率需要重新集成或剥离，否则登录/支付/广告功能会失效。
ai_analysis.dependencies: 运行时依赖：现代浏览器（Canvas/WebGL、WebAudio）、Cocos HTML5 引擎；外部依赖：1) syyxh5frameworksdk 所需的渠道服务器（登录、支付、广告、统计）；2) _remote/91d4a19849c304ed/landscape.gif 等远端资源及可能的热更新 CDN；3) bundle 加载依赖当前域或 CORS 配置；4) 可能与特定 Referer、域名白名单、签名验证强绑定；5) game bundle 中的 .bin 若依赖原生插件或 WebAssembly，需要对应运行时支持。
ai_analysis.verification_limits: 1) 仅有静态文件清单，无运行时行为，无法断言玩法、关卡、数值、网络同步是否正确；2) JS 代码已压缩混淆，核心逻辑不可直接阅读；3) 第三方 SDK 的授权范围、反调试/反篡改机制未知；4) 文件清单末尾截断，无法确认所有被引用的资源是否完整；5) 无法判断是否存在服务端校验、热更新协议、加密资源或 DRM；6) 不能声称完整验收或完全可玩，只能确认这是一个结构完整的 Cocos Web 运行包。
ai_analysis.next_checks: 1) 在受控浏览器/headless 环境启动，观察 console 报错、网络请求与 bundle 加载顺序；2) 解析 src/settings.618cd.js，提取启动场景、bundle 版本与 remote server 配置；3) 格式化/反混淆 main.js 与 syyxh5frameworksdk.js，识别渠道 API、签名逻辑、域名白名单；4) 校验各 config.json 中引用的 UUID 与 import/native 文件是否齐全（需补全被截断的清单）；5) 对 game bundle 的 .bin 做二进制/反编译分析，确认是否为压缩场景、图集或 WASM；6) 核对资源 hash 与文件名一致性，排查缺失或损坏；7) 法律合规审查：确认是否拥有源码、素材与 SDK 的再分发/修改授权。

game_profile.category: 阵容策略 / 自动战斗 / 关卡闯关
game_profile.perspective: 侧视战斗，竖屏布局；卡通角色在森林场景中从两侧交战。
game_profile.core_gameplay: 玩家选择上阵英雄，开始战斗后由角色自动移动和攻击，通过伤害与血量变化决定胜负。胜利领取金币并解锁下一关。
game_profile.core_experience: 战前选择队伍，战中通过角色动作、攻击效果、伤害数字和血条获得直观反馈，战后通过关卡推进获得明确目标。操作负担较低，当前两名可用角色提供有限的阵容选择。
game_profile.controls: 鼠标点击或触屏点击。点击地图骷髅进入布阵，点击英雄切换上阵状态，点击开始战斗；胜利后点击空白返回地图，再点击骷髅继续。
game_profile.game_loop: 进入地图 → 选择关卡 → 配置队伍 → 自动战斗 → 胜利结算 → 返回地图 → 进入下一关。五关完成后战役结束。失败不推进关卡，可再次挑战。
game_profile.content: 2名初始角色（101和401），最多5个队伍槽位；5个关卡，每关1波敌人。敌方使用角色101，生命、物理及魔法伤害、防御的基础属性倍率依次为0.55、0.65、0.75、0.85、0.95。
game_profile.progression: 每关胜利奖励100金币，五关共500金币。同一场战斗不重复发奖。金币当前仅作为累计奖励，没有消费或升级用途。没有离线收益。
game_profile.save: 在当前浏览器保存金币与关卡进度，刷新后恢复，不跨设备同步。整段战役重开需清理该游戏的浏览器存档；没有游戏内重置入口。

PAUSE / GUIDE

HYPER STRIKE
OBJECTIVE
Survive each wave, keep the kill chain alive, collect upgrades, and destroy the capital ship turrets during the flyover. When the Void Serpent arrives, break every segment of its tail — the moment the last one shatters you dive into the Core Breach: a chase-camera finish where you dodge the maw fire, shoot out its shield cores, then destroy the exposed head before the countdown ends. Bombs and Blast Charge work there too.
CONTROLS
WASD or arrows fly. Click and drag to move the ship. Space spends a nova bomb. Shift triggers Blast Charge when charged. P or Escape resumes.
THREATS
Interceptors chase, drones crowd the lane, bombers flood space with orbs, elites alternate aimed volleys and rings, capital turrets fire from the deck, and the serpent body rams.
PICKUPS
W
WEAPON
Guns + beam up
BOMB
Nova refill
SHARD
Blast Charge energy
Weapon cores raise firepower to level 5, then keep leveling the Blast Charge beam up to level 9. Getting hit drops weapon level by 1. Bomb cores refill nova bombs, and shards charge Blast Charge.
RESUME

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。

vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。

所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

ai_analysis.summary: The package is a Construct 3 HTML5 browser export of a fish/shark-themed arcade game (inferred from jaws_*, fish*, explosion*, and aquatic background assets). The runtime starts successfully in an isolated browser replica: one canvas, WebGL 2 / SwiftShader rendering, no missing external requests, no uncaught startup errors, and default IndexedDB entries for musicOnOff/soundOnOff only. A mini-game-sdk patch is applied that explicitly fails rewarded ads on localhost and avoids fake login/rewards. Only the startup phase has been observed; no gameplay, input, audio, ad mediation, progression, or monetization paths have been exercised.
ai_analysis.secondary_dev_boundary: This is a compiled Construct 3 deployment artifact, not an editable source project. Secondary development is therefore bounded to: (1) DOM/UI changes through style.css, (2) host/initialization configuration and ad adapter logic in config.js / ad.js, (3) service-worker and offline behavior in register-sw.js / offlineclient.js, (4) asset replacement (images/*.png, media/*) provided sheet layouts, file names, and audio formats stay compatible, and (5) adding external JS hooks around the runtime. Core gameplay logic lives inside minified c3runtime.js and generated data.json / scripts/project/scriptsInEvents.js; meaningful rule changes require the original .c3p project or re-export from Construct 3. Hand-editing data.json or the runtime is unsupported and likely to corrupt the project.

runtime_hooks: External adapter code injected around c3runtime.js; not runtime internals
project_scripts: scripts/project/scriptsInEvents.js are generated/minified; editable only through Construct 3 re-export

portable_modules.note: Host-specific UI, ad SDK adapter, and initialization flags.
Engine core; moves as a bundle and must match the data.json version.
Generated Construct 3 project; treat as read-only outside the editor.
Can be adapted per deployment origin and cache strategy.
Sprite sheets, backgrounds, effects, music, and SFX.
Observed only default musicOnOff/soundOnOff flags.

dependencies: Modern browser with WebGL 2 support (Canvas 2D fallback may exist but not verified)
Construct 3 runtime engine and the exact plugin/behavior set encoded in data.json
Service Worker capable HTTPS or localhost origin with correct scope
Audio codecs: Ogg Vorbis, WebM audio, AAC/M4A depending on target platform
localStorage and IndexedDB for settings and save-like storage
Ad SDK / mediation integration if rewarded/interstitial ads are enabled (currently patched to fail)
Touch and/or keyboard input for the observed touchareaP1/P2 and implied versus controls
verification_limits: Only the startup phase was observed (~9.6 s); replay_action_count is 0 and no user interactions were performed.
WebGL rendering used SwiftShader, producing ReadPixels GPU-stall warnings; performance is not representative of target hardware.
IndexedDB snapshot contains only default musicOnOff/soundOnOff values; no progression, score, unlock, or cross-store atomicity can be verified.
Rewarded ads are patched to explicitly fail on localhost; no real ad network or mediation flow has been validated.
No gameplay assertions can be made: movement, collision, AI, scoring, level loading, game-over, versus mode, and audio playback are unverified.
Core code is minified/compiled; direct security or logic audit is not possible without the original .c3p source or a deobfuscation effort.
No external network requests were observed during startup, but dynamic requests may occur after gameplay starts.
next_checks: Gameplay smoke test: start game, control shark/fish, trigger eat/collision, score, and game-over states.
Input verification for both P1 and P2 touch areas and any keyboard/watch unlock inputs.
Audio playback verification on target devices, including codec fallback paths.
End-to-end ad integration test with real mediation SDK after removing or configuring the localhost patch.
Real-device GPU profiling and input latency measurement; investigate SwiftShader ReadPixels stalls.
Save/load and progression persistence across sessions, including cross-store consistency.
Asset completeness and license clearance for all fish, shark, explosion, background, and music assets.
Diff against a clean Construct 3 export from the source .c3p to confirm no unauthorized runtime modifications.
PWA manifest, icons, service-worker scope, and offline cache behavior.
Security/CSP and iframe integration tests if deployed inside a mini-game platform.
Versus mode validation if the versusmode.ogg asset indicates a two-player mode.

ai_analysis.summary: The package is a Construct 3 HTML5 browser export of a fish/shark-themed arcade game (inferred from jaws_*, fish*, explosion*, and aquatic background assets). The runtime starts successfully in an isolated browser replica: one canvas, WebGL 2 / SwiftShader rendering, no missing external requests, no uncaught startup errors, and default IndexedDB entries for musicOnOff/soundOnOff only. A mini-game-sdk patch is applied that explicitly fails rewarded ads on localhost and avoids fake login/rewards. Only the startup phase has been observed; no gameplay, input, audio, ad mediation, progression, or monetization paths have been exercised.
ai_analysis.secondary_dev_boundary: This is a compiled Construct 3 deployment artifact, not an editable source project. Secondary development is therefore bounded to: (1) DOM/UI changes through style.css, (2) host/initialization configuration and ad adapter logic in config.js / ad.js, (3) service-worker and offline behavior in register-sw.js / offlineclient.js, (4) asset replacement (images/*.png, media/*) provided sheet layouts, file names, and audio formats stay compatible, and (5) adding external JS hooks around the runtime. Core gameplay logic lives inside minified c3runtime.js and generated data.json / scripts/project/scriptsInEvents.js; meaningful rule changes require the original .c3p project or re-export from Construct 3. Hand-editing data.json or the runtime is unsupported and likely to corrupt the project.

runtime_hooks: External adapter code injected around c3runtime.js; not runtime internals
project_scripts: scripts/project/scriptsInEvents.js are generated/minified; editable only through Construct 3 re-export

verification_limits: Only the startup phase was observed (~9.6 s); replay_action_count is 0 and no user interactions were performed.
WebGL rendering used SwiftShader, producing ReadPixels GPU-stall warnings; performance is not representative of target hardware.

Rewarded ads are patched to explicitly fail on localhost; no real ad network or mediation flow has been validated.
No gameplay assertions can be made: movement, collision, AI, scoring, level loading, game-over, versus mode, and audio playback are unverified.
Core code is minified/compiled; direct security or logic audit is not possible without the original .c3p source or a deobfuscation effort.
No external network requests were observed during startup, but dynamic requests may occur after gameplay starts.

Real-device GPU profiling and input latency measurement; investigate SwiftShader ReadPixels stalls.
Save/load and progression persistence across sessions, including cross-store consistency.
Asset completeness and license clearance for all fish, shark, explosion, background, and music assets.
Diff against a clean Construct 3 export from the source .c3p to confirm no unauthorized runtime modifications.

game_profile.category: 阵容策略 / 自动战斗 / 关卡闯关
game_profile.perspective: 侧视战斗，竖屏布局；卡通角色在森林场景中从两侧交战。
game_profile.core_gameplay: 玩家选择上阵英雄，开始战斗后由角色自动移动和攻击，通过伤害与血量变化决定胜负。胜利领取金币并解锁下一关。
game_profile.core_experience: 战前选择队伍，战中通过角色动作、攻击效果、伤害数字和血条获得直观反馈，战后通过关卡推进获得明确目标。操作负担较低，当前两名可用角色提供有限的阵容选择。
game_profile.controls: 鼠标点击或触屏点击。点击地图骷髅进入布阵，点击英雄切换上阵状态，点击开始战斗；胜利后点击空白返回地图，再点击骷髅继续。
game_profile.game_loop: 进入地图 → 选择关卡 → 配置队伍 → 自动战斗 → 胜利结算 → 返回地图 → 进入下一关。五关完成后战役结束。失败不推进关卡，可再次挑战。
game_profile.content: 2名初始角色（101和401），最多5个队伍槽位；5个关卡，每关1波敌人。敌方使用角色101，生命、物理及魔法伤害、防御的基础属性倍率依次为0.55、0.65、0.75、0.85、0.95。
game_profile.progression: 每关胜利奖励100金币，五关共500金币。同一场战斗不重复发奖。金币当前仅作为累计奖励，没有消费或升级用途。没有离线收益。
game_profile.save: 在当前浏览器保存金币与关卡进度，刷新后恢复，不跨设备同步。整段战役重开需清理该游戏的浏览器存档；没有游戏内重置入口。

ai_analysis.summary: A Flash game (hunl2zw.swf) packaged with Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 (ruffle.js, core JS, WASM). Two patches redirect the portal loading UI to a standalone local player and enforce a local-only resource policy. The runtime reports loaded=true and playerState=2 with no runtime errors, missing assets, external requests, or blocked navigation. However, canvasCount=0, buttons/labels arrays are empty, and no replay actions were performed. WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings appear but do not stop initialization. This is evidence of successful engine/ asset startup, not proof of playable gameplay.

can_edit: index.html host wrapper and Ruffle player configuration (autoplay, scale, wmode, quality, base URL, context menu, allowNetworking)
loader/branding UI that replaces the original portal frame
local-content policy filters (what local files may be loaded, analytics/tracking removal)
file paths and packaging layout as long as relative references remain valid
isolated storage scope settings and service-worker behavior
SWF replacement only by overwriting hunl2zw.swf with a binary-compatible asset
cannot_edit_without_reverse_engineering: original hunl2zw.swf internal ActionScript, symbols, or timeline logic
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: The current package is a wrapper-level port. Modification must stay within the host page, config, local policy, and asset substitution. Recompiling the emulator core or altering SWF internals is outside the licensed/verified boundary. The game must continue to load local-only resources and must not be repackaged as a different title.

dependencies: Browser or runtime with WebAssembly and WebGL 2 support
Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 build matching the bundled JS/WASM
Correct MIME types for .wasm (application/wasm) and .swf (application/x-shockwave-flash or application/octet-stream)
Local file or static HTTP origin (origin spoofed as https://replica-runtime.invalid in the observed runtime)
Optional: localStorage/sessionStorage permission if the SWF uses SharedObject
No observed external dependencies; original analytics/ads/nav portals are explicitly excluded by local-content policy
verification_limits: Runtime 'passed' only confirms the engine initialized and the SWF reached playerState=2; it does not confirm interactive gameplay
canvasCount=0 and empty buttons/labels arrays mean no HTML-level interactive elements were detected; this may be an instrumentation gap or the SWF stage may not be exposed as a <canvas> element
Only one startup screenshot is referenced; no post-intro, menu, in-game, or save/load screenshots
No replay actions were executed, so input response, scoring, progression, and win/loss states are unverified
WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings indicate the wgpu-webgl renderer may differ from native Flash/Adobe player rendering
Storage snapshot is read-only and isolated; it cannot prove that game progress loads or persists correctly
The index.html hash changed, but the actual patch diff is not provided, so the exact host behavior cannot be audited
Runtime origin is a synthetic invalid URL; results may not transfer to a real deployment domain
next_checks: Execute scripted replay actions (keyboard/mouse) and assert visible state changes or score/level changes
Capture screenshots beyond startup: title screen, main menu, first interactive frame, and after a save/load cycle
Inspect SWF metadata (dimensions, ActionScript version, frame rate, symbols) and compare file hash to a known original
Verify whether canvasCount=0 is a measurement bug by checking the actual DOM for Ruffle's stage container
Test audio playback and mute behavior
Test local save/load by writing a SharedObject/localStorage value and reloading the page
Run with browser devtools network logging to confirm zero external requests under local-content policy
Review the exact index.html patch diff to ensure no unintended redirects or scripts were added
Test on multiple browsers/operating systems to validate WebGL compatibility and input handling
Profile frame timing to ensure the WebGL warnings do not cause stalls during gameplay

ai_analysis.summary: 当前材料为一个基于 Cocos Creator 2.x（engine: cocos2）构建的网页游戏运行包。文件结构包含标准 Cocos 引擎运行时（cocos2d-js-min.js、physics-min.js）、启动入口（main.js、settings.js、style-mobile.css）以及 asset bundle：internal、resources、main、Game。运行时快照显示场景 Game 已加载，视口 1000×760，存在 startBtn（绑定 onJoinRoomClick）与玩家名称标签，localStorage 中观察到两条记录（语言、存档键）。已对 mini-game-sdk 做本地补丁：激励广告显式失败，未伪造登录/奖励。存在 1 个资源预加载 404：assets/Game/import/06/062ffdd5-8476-4d46-8b3d-3dd852490dbd@6c48a.json。由于未执行实际玩法断言，不能声称完整验收。该运行包是编译后的产物，二次开发边界为：可在 bundle 外修改启动配置、CSS、settings.js、SDK 存根与替换贴图/音频/JSON 元数据；Game 与 resources bundle 内的已编译脚本和场景依赖 Cocos Creator 原项目才能安全重构，直接改编译产物风险高且难以回建。
editable_logic: src/settings.js — 平台/渲染/分组/初始场景配置；
style-mobile.css — 视口、横竖屏提示、UI 基础样式；
main.js — 启动流程、bundle 预加载列表、Cocos 启动参数；
mini-game-sdk 补丁 — 本地广告/登录/支付存根行为（当前激励广告显式失败）；
assets/{resources,Game}/config.json 与 import/*.json — 资源映射、prefab/spriteFrame 元数据（需谨慎，UUID 与依赖关系强绑定）；
native 资源文件 — png/mp3/atlas 可按同名同格式替换；
不可安全编辑：已压缩/编译的 cocos2d-js-min.js、physics-min.js、assets/Game/index.cc6e8.js、assets/main/index.js 等核心逻辑，除非拥有 Creator 原项目并重新构建。
portable_modules: Cocos 引擎标准运行时（cocos2d-js-min.js、physics-min.js）可在同版本项目中替换或升级；
internal bundle 为引擎默认资源，通常可跨同版本项目复用；
resources bundle（通用资源、音效、配置 JSON）相对独立，可被其他同引擎项目按 UUID 引用；
Game bundle（场景、脚本、贴图）业务耦合度高，移植需同步其 config.json/import 索引及原生资源目录；
独立原生素材（png/mp3/atlas）可按 assets/Game/native 与 assets/resources/native 的 UUID 目录结构平移。
dependencies: 浏览器环境：WebGL（运行时出现 ReadPixels GPU stall 性能警告）、Canvas、CSS pixel ratio；
JS 加载链：settings.js → main.js → cocos2d-js-min.js → physics-min.js → 各 asset bundle index.js；
Asset bundle 系统：main/config.json、Game/config.json、resources/config.json 及 import/native 目录；
平台 SDK：mini-game-sdk（本地补丁替代真实广告/登录/支付），真实宿主需接入 wx/tt/qq 等 API；
存储：localStorage（sr-datoudingxiaotou_language、sr-datoudingxiaotou_storage），sessionStorage/IndexedDB 当前未实际使用；
运行时域：https://replica-runtime.invalid，本地环境不代表目标宿主（微信/抖音小游戏等）的域名、权限与网络策略。
verification_limits: 仅观察到启动场景 Game 与非循环运行时，未执行实际玩法断言，无法确认核心循环、胜负条件、网络同步正确性；
存储哈希仅能证明 key-value 存在，不能证明存档被正确解析、加载或回写；
单个 404（assets/Game/import/06/062ffdd5-8476-4d46-8b3d-3dd852490dbd@6c48a.json）未解释其用途，不能判断是否为关键资源缺失或冗余请求；
本地 mini-game-sdk 补丁下广告显式失败，未验证真实平台广告回调、奖励发放与登录流程；
WebGL ReadPixels GPU stall 仅为性能提示，未在目标设备/浏览器上复现；
文件列表为快照，未校验所有 import JSON 与 native 文件的 SHA/UUID 一致性；
未提供源码，无法审计 Game bundle 内脚本安全、合规性与平台限制 API 使用。
next_checks: 完整走一遍核心玩法流程并记录运行时错误与网络请求；
定位并修复/确认 404 资源影响范围（检查 Game/config.json 中 UUID 062ffdd5-8476-4d46-8b3d-3dd852490dbd 的引用）；
对比 settings.js 与目标平台（小游戏/H5）配置，确认 bundle 列表、渲染后端、适配策略；
对 localStorage 存档键做读写一致性测试（保存-刷新-读取-恢复）；
在真实目标平台或等效 SDK 环境下测试登录、激励广告、分享回调；
校验所有 asset bundle 的 config.json 与 import/native 文件完整性和 UUID 映射；
检查 assets/Game/index.cc6e8.js 与相关 .js 是否存在平台限制 API（如 wx.*、tt.*）并准备 polyfill；
测试横屏提示 landscape.gif 与 viewport 1000×760 在目标设备上的适配表现。

gameplay_spec.evidence_scope: Recognizable mechanics are described in promotional page text, but no gameplay was observed or played. Supplied code excerpts show infrastructure and runtime helpers rather than gameplay logic. Rules below are documentary claims or explicit inferences, not verified behavior.

observed_rules.rule: Run along subway tracks while avoiding approaching trains and obstacles.
Collect coins, keys and power-ups; currency is described as supporting character unlocks and purchases of assistance items.
A jetpack enables powered flight, a magnet attracts coins, and a shield provides protection against obstacles.
The page advertises multiple maps, selectable characters with distinct skills, and global score competition.

inferred_rules.rule: Forward movement likely continues automatically while the player controls lateral movement, jumping and crouching.
inferred_rules.basis: Running gameplay and directional swipe controls

inferred_rules.rule: Jumping and crouching likely avoid different obstacle geometries.
inferred_rules.basis: These actions are described as tools for avoiding danger

inferred_rules.rule: Unprotected collisions likely penalize or end a run.
inferred_rules.basis: Obstacle avoidance and shield protection are described; collision consequences are unspecified

unknowns: Whether the packaged game implements the promotional claims; the page also uses the name 地铁酷派.
Lane count and whether lateral movement is discrete or continuous.
Collision outcomes, lives, revival and run termination.
Score formula, win conditions and whether runs are endless.
Movement speed, acceleration, jump physics and crouch duration.
Power-up duration, attraction radius, shield consumption and stacking.
Currency values, purchase costs, persistence and character skills.
Actual task definitions, maps and competitive modes.
Desktop keyboard or mouse controls.
Launch requirements and whether WeChat is required. Both supplied frames report zero canvases; this does not establish a launch failure.

controls.basis: Explicit page instruction and promotional description
Observed page button text; resulting behavior unknown

ai_analysis.summary: 这是一个 Cocos Creator 2.x（Cocos2d-JS）HTML5 构建包的标准文件清单：入口为 main.js + settings.js，引擎核心为 cocos2d-js-min.js，资源按功能分包为 internal、resources、resources_sounds、resources_map、resources_skeleton、resources_ui_II、resources_dynamic，并包含 gdAd.js 广告 SDK 集成。当前可二次开发的边界主要在：替换或增删符合原有 UUID/配置格式的资源文件、修改 settings.js 中的引擎/屏幕/分包参数、在 main.js 未被混淆的前提下调整启动配置；游戏核心玩法逻辑已被编译/压缩到 main.js 与各 bundle 的 index.js 中，没有原始工程时难以进行深度逻辑改动或完整验收。
ai_analysis.editable_logic: settings.js 中的引擎渲染、屏幕方向、分包列表与基础启动参数；各 asset bundle 的 config.json 中的资源映射、UUID 对应关系、版本号；gdAd.js 若未压缩可调整广告调用封装；main.js 仅在可读/未混淆情况下可修改启动流程。已编译的场景、脚本、动画状态机等逻辑不可直接编辑。

ai_analysis.summary: 该运行时包为浏览器端网页游戏《Artillerie Duell》（炮兵对决/坦克决斗）。启动阶段验证通过：菜单渲染正常、3 个 canvas、字体与按钮就位、无运行时报错、无缺失文件、无被拦截的外部请求。但现有证据仅限启动菜单画面，未触发任何实际玩法交互；源码静态分析仅覆盖 3 个不超过 1MB 的脚本，且 editable_project_verified 为 false。因此只能视为“可启动、具备二次开发素材基础的候选包”，不能据此声称完整验收。
ai_analysis.editable_logic: 二次开发边界受限于当前交付的运行时文件，而非已验证的可编辑工程。核心玩法逻辑分散在 main.js、tank.js、terrain.js、physics.js 等纯 JavaScript 文件中，可直接进行文本级修改；rosebud-game-defaults.js/css 提供框架默认样式与配置。但 _remote/ 下的 ScriptsLoader-Universal.js、ChatManager.js、ImageGenerator.js、ProgressLogger.js、OGP.js 可能包含原平台（疑似 Rosebud 生态）的加载器、聊天/图片生成/埋点/Open Graph 钩子，若脱离原宿主可能需要本地桩（stub）或重写。index.html 已被 patch（仅提供 before/after 哈希，未给出 diff），其引导逻辑是修改边界的关键。整体可运行、可脚本级魔改，但无法直接导入官方编辑器进行可视化二次开发。

gameplay_spec.evidence_quality: Recognizable mechanics are described in page text, but no gameplay execution is shown. Rules below distinguish documented claims from code observations and inference.

observed_rules.rule: Eat smaller fish to grow; avoid larger fish that can eat the player.
Select a fish before beginning play.
Feeding enables growth and evolution into stronger forms.
Hidden cave energy grants temporary invincibility.
Plankton can serve as food; sharks and giant squid are described as threats.
The supplied open-data code stores score, fishId and timestamps, and sorts retrieved ranking entries by descending score.

inferred_rules.rule: Growth likely expands the set of fish the player can consume.
Consumption likely requires proximity or collision with eligible prey.
inferred_rules.basis: Eating is described, but collision handling is absent.

inferred_rules.rule: Being eaten likely causes a failure or respawn transition.
inferred_rules.basis: Larger fish are described as lethal threats; the resulting transition is unspecified.

inferred_rules.rule: Friend and group leaderboards may be available.
inferred_rules.basis: Supplied code exposes friend and group ranking retrieval, but no corresponding game UI is shown.

unknowns: Actual runtime behavior and whether page instructions match this game version.
Size comparison thresholds and equal-size interactions.
Growth amounts, evolution thresholds and available fish forms.
Scoring formula and when records are submitted.
Collision geometry, attack behavior and predator AI.
Boost duration, cooldown, cost and mouse-button semantics.
Touch and keyboard controls.
Health, lives, failure, respawn and restart behavior.
Invincibility duration, activation conditions and exact effects.
Map layout, boundaries, spawning, levels and victory conditions.
Whether fish selection, plankton and cave power-ups exist in the runtime.

controls.effect: Controls fish swimming direction; the page says the fish follows the mouse.

controls.unknown_details: Button, hold-versus-click behavior, duration and resource cost.

controls.effect: Page provides an entry point for launching the game.

states.name: Detail page
states.evidence: Game description and Start Game entry point.

acceptance_tests.action: During active play, move the mouse to different positions.
acceptance_tests.expected: Fish swimming responds toward the mouse as documented.

acceptance_tests.action: Click the mouse while swimming and compare movement speed with baseline.
Attempt to consume a clearly smaller fish.
Encounter a clearly larger predator without protection.
acceptance_tests.expected: The predator can eat the player; record the resulting state without assuming restart behavior.

acceptance_tests.action: Feed repeatedly while recording size and form.
acceptance_tests.expected: Growth occurs; determine whether and when evolution occurs.

acceptance_tests.action: If cave energy exists, activate it and encounter a predator during and after its effect.
acceptance_tests.expected: Temporary protection occurs and subsequently expires.

acceptance_tests.action: Evaluate the supplied ranking transformation with distinct numeric scores.
acceptance_tests.expected: Entries with stored ranking data are returned in descending score order.

limitations: Growth thresholds, collision rules, scoring, boost timing, cave timing, and victory conditions are original design choices because runtime details were unspecified.
Session best is memory-only; friend/group leaderboards and specialized shark or squid enemies are not implemented.

ai_analysis.summary: 该包为 Cocos Creator 导出的 Web（HTML5）构建产物，包含 cocos-js 引擎、system 加载器、import-map、settings、main/resources/internal 资源包以及 Physics/Spine 等 WASM/ASM 模块。运行时能够在隔离浏览器环境中启动，创建 1 个 WebGL canvas，未触发脚本报错，引擎与主资源已加载；但当前只捕获到启动瞬间截图，未观察到按钮、标签、可点击入口或实际玩法画面，无法确认游戏入口是否可达。外部广告 SDK 端点 https://dssp.stnts.com/ 的请求被阻断，且已被标注为本地宿主/激励广告显式失败，不生成伪造登录或奖励。多个装饰性图片缺失，按用户要求不再阻断转换，但需验证是否影响首屏渲染。

editable_logic.description: 当前为已编译的发布包，核心逻辑以压缩/混淆后的 bundle JS 与 JSON 配置形式存在，可直接修改的范围受限于运行时加载体系。
modifiable: assets/main/config.185d1.json 与 index.185d1.js：主场景包配置与脚本，可替换场景、预制体引用或注入调试日志。
assets/resources/config.09dce.json 与 index.09dce.js：资源包配置与脚本，可调整动态资源路径、分包策略。
assets/Scripts/config.11e73.json 与 index.11e73.js：业务脚本入口，可修改初始化、事件注册、平台桥接逻辑。
src/settings.a4720.json：引擎启动参数（渲染后端、物理引擎、适配策略等）。
src/import-map.31c03.json 与 src/chunks/bundle.fc9a0.js：模块映射与 chunk，可重定向模块加载。
style.css：页面样式、canvas 容器、loading 遮罩。
src/assets/Scripts/Plugins/Plugin.629b4.js：插件脚本，可替换或打补丁。
缺失装饰性资源的 404 fallback 与路径映射。
frozen: cocos-js/cc.5440a.js 与 _virtual_cc-ca659014.js 等引擎核心文件：修改需对应引擎源码重新构建，否则易出现 ABI/版本不一致。
WASM 二进制（bullet/spine/meshopt）及 ASM 回退：只能整体替换对应版本编译产物，不能直接改内部逻辑。
system.bundle / polyfills：运行时加载器，通常保持原样。
editable_logic.boundary: 二次开发边界在于：可在 Cocos 资源/脚本/配置层做运行时补丁与资源替换，也可针对小游戏平台补充平台桥接（登录、广告、支付）的 stub；但若要改动引擎渲染、物理、Spine 运行时行为，必须回到原始 Cocos Creator 工程重新导出，否则风险不可控。当前包未附带 source map，调试与修改成本较高。

ai_analysis.summary: A Flash game (hunl2zw.swf) packaged with Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 (ruffle.js, core JS, WASM). Two patches redirect the portal loading UI to a standalone local player and enforce a local-only resource policy. The runtime reports loaded=true and playerState=2 with no runtime errors, missing assets, external requests, or blocked navigation. However, canvasCount=0, buttons/labels arrays are empty, and no replay actions were performed. WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings appear but do not stop initialization. This is evidence of successful engine/ asset startup, not proof of playable gameplay.

can_edit: index.html host wrapper and Ruffle player configuration (autoplay, scale, wmode, quality, base URL, context menu, allowNetworking)
loader/branding UI that replaces the original portal frame
local-content policy filters (what local files may be loaded, analytics/tracking removal)
file paths and packaging layout as long as relative references remain valid
isolated storage scope settings and service-worker behavior
SWF replacement only by overwriting hunl2zw.swf with a binary-compatible asset
cannot_edit_without_reverse_engineering: original hunl2zw.swf internal ActionScript, symbols, or timeline logic
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: The current package is a wrapper-level port. Modification must stay within the host page, config, local policy, and asset substitution. Recompiling the emulator core or altering SWF internals is outside the licensed/verified boundary. The game must continue to load local-only resources and must not be repackaged as a different title.

dependencies: Browser or runtime with WebAssembly and WebGL 2 support
Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 build matching the bundled JS/WASM
Correct MIME types for .wasm (application/wasm) and .swf (application/x-shockwave-flash or application/octet-stream)
Local file or static HTTP origin (origin spoofed as https://replica-runtime.invalid in the observed runtime)
Optional: localStorage/sessionStorage permission if the SWF uses SharedObject
No observed external dependencies; original analytics/ads/nav portals are explicitly excluded by local-content policy
verification_limits: Runtime 'passed' only confirms the engine initialized and the SWF reached playerState=2; it does not confirm interactive gameplay
canvasCount=0 and empty buttons/labels arrays mean no HTML-level interactive elements were detected; this may be an instrumentation gap or the SWF stage may not be exposed as a <canvas> element
Only one startup screenshot is referenced; no post-intro, menu, in-game, or save/load screenshots
No replay actions were executed, so input response, scoring, progression, and win/loss states are unverified
WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings indicate the wgpu-webgl renderer may differ from native Flash/Adobe player rendering
Storage snapshot is read-only and isolated; it cannot prove that game progress loads or persists correctly
The index.html hash changed, but the actual patch diff is not provided, so the exact host behavior cannot be audited
Runtime origin is a synthetic invalid URL; results may not transfer to a real deployment domain
next_checks: Execute scripted replay actions (keyboard/mouse) and assert visible state changes or score/level changes
Capture screenshots beyond startup: title screen, main menu, first interactive frame, and after a save/load cycle
Inspect SWF metadata (dimensions, ActionScript version, frame rate, symbols) and compare file hash to a known original
Verify whether canvasCount=0 is a measurement bug by checking the actual DOM for Ruffle's stage container
Test audio playback and mute behavior
Test local save/load by writing a SharedObject/localStorage value and reloading the page
Run with browser devtools network logging to confirm zero external requests under local-content policy
Review the exact index.html patch diff to ensure no unintended redirects or scripts were added
Test on multiple browsers/operating systems to validate WebGL compatibility and input handling
Profile frame timing to ensure the WebGL warnings do not cause stalls during gameplay

WASD or arrows fly. Click and drag to move the ship. Space spends a nova bomb. Shift triggers Blast Charge when charged. P or Escape resumes.

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。
二次开发边界: 当前可确认的包级边界是所列静态 HTML、JavaScript 供应库和音频资源。若 index.html 中包含可读的应用代码，可在核实脚本结构后修改；目前不能确认这一点。
vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。
清单含多个名称或版本不同的 Three.js 文件。未检查加载顺序和模块依赖前，不应假定它们都被使用，也不应随意删除或替换。
所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

portable_modules.evidence: 启动运行文本显示分数、生命、武器、炸弹、控制提示及启动、指南相关界面文字。
portable_modules.portability: 可确认这些文字在启动检查中出现，不能据此确认对应按钮、HUD 更新或交互逻辑可移植且正常工作。

dependencies: 包内依赖至少包括 index.html、所列 JavaScript 文件及 WAV 资源；记录中未观察到外部网络请求，但这只覆盖该次启动路径。
运行记录报告浏览器中创建了一个 canvas，并加载了字体；WebGL 在该次运行中可启动，但兼容性和其他设备表现未验证。
页面交互依赖 DOM；图形和声音分别依赖浏览器图形与音频能力。音频资源是否能在用户手势后正常播放尚未检查。
多个 Three.js 文件可能引入版本冲突、全局变量覆盖或重复加载风险；需要依据实际脚本引用和运行时模块图确认。
存储检查仅覆盖隔离页面中的 localStorage 和 sessionStorage，二者记录为空；IndexedDB 与内存状态未检查。
verification_limits: 检查记录报告运行通过、无错误、无缺失文件、无预加载错误，且启动界面已加载；这些是所给记录的结果，并非独立复测结论。
replay_action_count 为 0，actions 为空。鼠标或键盘移动、攻击、炸弹、爆破蓄力、暂停、关卡推进、首领战、受伤、结算及重开均未验证。
页面上显示的控制提示只证明提示文字出现，不证明相应输入有效。
仅有启动截图，未提供玩法过程截图、视频、操作日志、原作对照或行为断言；不能据此判断移植忠实度或完整度。
local-static-references 修改的哈希记录不等于源码差异审查；无法据此确认修改内容、兼容性或第三方库授权状态。
运行日志出现多条 GPU stall / ReadPixels 性能提示；其影响程度和是否由测试工具导致尚不清楚。
next_checks: 取得实际解包文件树、index.html 和相关脚本源码，核对资源路径、脚本加载顺序、实际使用的 Three.js 版本，并审查所列修改的源码差异。
在可重复的浏览器会话中记录真实输入与结果，至少检查启动、移动、攻击、炸弹、爆破蓄力、暂停与恢复、受伤、关卡推进、结算和重开；为每项定义可观察的通过条件。
保存带操作过程的截图或视频、浏览器控制台与网络记录，并将实际动作计数纳入验收材料；在获得玩法断言前，不标记玩法完整验收。
若原游戏设计包含进度保存，分别检查 localStorage、sessionStorage、IndexedDB 和重新载入后的状态；若不包含，记录该项不适用的依据。
在目标浏览器及不同窗口尺寸下复测 WebGL、字体、音频、输入和性能；确认 GPU stall 日志的影响。
复核静态包的文件清单、依赖来源、资源使用权和发布许可，再确定可发布范围。

report.summary: 本轮沿已保存草稿继续验证，未再修改源码或广告逻辑。基于修复后的公共截图链路，实机画面已能正常显示第1关球杆试用新手引导：球台、白球、目标球、球杆、瞄准辅助线、底部方向滑动条及右侧道具面板均渲染正确。在竖屏 390×844 下对底部方向滑动条执行多次水平拖拽，滑动条上的手指图标产生明显位移，证明触摸输入被游戏真实接收并产生可观察反馈，满足“新手引导需至少一次真实操作有可观察反馈”的验证要求。此前刷新实验已观察到 localStorage 中 user1/other1 内容在 reload 前后发生变化且跨会话保持，说明游戏正在使用本地存储进行存档读写。runtime 未报告任何外部 HTTP 请求，广告初始化错误 `r is not defined` 已被 local-host.js 中的 StageBannerMgr 离线补丁屏蔽，未阻断场景启动与引导流程。本轮验证终点为新手引导（tutorial），未推进到正式击球/进洞/结算的 gameplay 闭环，因此未覆盖的后续关卡、商城、PVP、排行榜、完整物理反馈等不纳入本次闭合范围。

新手引导场景及所需资源已实际加载并正常渲染；未游玩关卡与商城资源不在本次验证范围。
第1关/新手引导配置已生效：level_node 显示“1”，动态场景 game_newbie 正确实例化。
已验证的新手引导流程未产生外部 HTTP 请求；存档读写使用 localStorage 并在 reload 后保持。结算、广告奖励、排行榜等后端接口未在此流程触发，对当前验证终点不适用。
本地引擎启动通过；MINI_GAME_SDK 本地适配已提供必要存根，广告不伪造奖励。

CONTROLS
WASD or arrows fly. Click and drag to move the ship. Space spends a nova bomb. Shift triggers Blast Charge when charged. P or Escape resumes.
THREATS
Interceptors chase, drones crowd the lane, bombers flood space with orbs, elites alternate aimed volleys and rings, capital turrets fire from the deck, and the serpent body rams.

BOMB

SHARD
Blast Charge energy
Weapon cores raise firepower to level 5, then keep leveling the Blast Charge beam up to level 9. Getting hit drops weapon level by 1. Bomb cores refill nova bombs, and shards charge Blast Charge.

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。
二次开发边界: 当前可确认的包级边界是所列静态 HTML、JavaScript 供应库和音频资源。若 index.html 中包含可读的应用代码，可在核实脚本结构后修改；目前不能确认这一点。
vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。
清单含多个名称或版本不同的 Three.js 文件。未检查加载顺序和模块依赖前，不应假定它们都被使用，也不应随意删除或替换。
所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

game_profile.progression: 单局内累计分数与连击，配置支持随时间及tier提高难度；指南说明武器可提升至9级、受击降级，并有炸弹补给与能量碎片。完整升级链和后续阶段未验证。
game_profile.save: 已验证的代表性流程没有持久化续局：初始化创建标题新状态，重开重置单局；运行中及刷新前后可用且完整的localStorage/sessionStorage均为空，刷新从324分暂停状态回到0分标题。宿主与引擎具备保存接口，但所提供游戏生命周期没有接入保存或恢复，因此本流程保存恢复不适用；此结论不声称已穷举IndexedDB或一切动态调用。

storage.limitation: Storage hashes do not prove game progress was loaded. IndexedDB and exposed WASM /data files are read-only snapshots, not an atomic cross-store snapshot. Save bodies are never returned.

adblock.scope: Network ads/tracking only; no cosmetic injection, redirects, fake SDK success or gameplay acceptance

navigation_checkpoints.scope: Observed non-loopback runtime only; not a guarantee for unobserved timers or deployment configurations

ai_analysis.summary: Runtime startup passed: a single canvas rendered the title screen 'THE THERAPIST — PRESS ENTER TO START' at 1000×760 with fonts loaded. No gameplay actions were replayed, so this is a startup/loading evidence review, not a full acceptance test. A patch was applied to index.html. Static source analysis extracted three JS modules with webcrack, but editable_project_verified is false and runtime_modified is false. All observed runtime requests were internal; no external network calls were required or blocked under the tested adblockers.
ai_analysis.editable_logic: The current package is a browser runtime bundle, not a verified editable engine project. Secondary-development boundaries are: (1) index.html can be patched directly; (2) JS logic in main.js, ScriptsLoader-Universal.js, OGP.js, ProgressLogger.js, ImageGenerator.js and ChatManager.js can be edited as plain text after cleanup; (3) image/audio/font assets under assets/ and _remote/ can be replaced; (4) any Cocos/Builder-specific project regeneration or build pipeline remains unverified and may not be reconstructible from runtime files alone. Do not treat this as a complete, validated source project.

editable_logic.description: 当前为已编译的发布包，核心逻辑以压缩/混淆后的 bundle JS 与 JSON 配置形式存在，可直接修改的范围受限于运行时加载体系。
modifiable: assets/main/config.185d1.json 与 index.185d1.js：主场景包配置与脚本，可替换场景、预制体引用或注入调试日志。
assets/resources/config.09dce.json 与 index.09dce.js：资源包配置与脚本，可调整动态资源路径、分包策略。
assets/Scripts/config.11e73.json 与 index.11e73.js：业务脚本入口，可修改初始化、事件注册、平台桥接逻辑。
src/settings.a4720.json：引擎启动参数（渲染后端、物理引擎、适配策略等）。
src/import-map.31c03.json 与 src/chunks/bundle.fc9a0.js：模块映射与 chunk，可重定向模块加载。
style.css：页面样式、canvas 容器、loading 遮罩。
src/assets/Scripts/Plugins/Plugin.629b4.js：插件脚本，可替换或打补丁。
缺失装饰性资源的 404 fallback 与路径映射。
frozen: cocos-js/cc.5440a.js 与 _virtual_cc-ca659014.js 等引擎核心文件：修改需对应引擎源码重新构建，否则易出现 ABI/版本不一致。
WASM 二进制（bullet/spine/meshopt）及 ASM 回退：只能整体替换对应版本编译产物，不能直接改内部逻辑。
system.bundle / polyfills：运行时加载器，通常保持原样。
editable_logic.boundary: 二次开发边界在于：可在 Cocos 资源/脚本/配置层做运行时补丁与资源替换，也可针对小游戏平台补充平台桥接（登录、广告、支付）的 stub；但若要改动引擎渲染、物理、Spine 运行时行为，必须回到原始 Cocos Creator 工程重新导出，否则风险不可控。当前包未附带 source map，调试与修改成本较高。

portable_modules.note: 包含渲染、组件系统、资源管理，目标平台需支持 WebGL/WebGL2。

含动态加载的 cconb/json/png 等，部分装饰性资源缺失需补齐或屏蔽引用。
业务逻辑入口，可能包含平台相关代码，需要移植时替换为平台适配层。
bullet（wasm/asm）、spine（wasm/asm/js）、meshopt_decoder（wasm/asm），目标平台需支持对应二进制格式或启用 JS 回退。

report.summary: 本轮为最后一次调用，仅做评估。当前游戏仍停留在 Splash 启动画面（“3D 贪吃蛇大作战”标题、数字方块、网格背景），已执行 15 个动作（点击画布、Enter、Space、长时间等待）均未触发进入主菜单或玩法，runtime 未检测到按钮/标签，storage 中仅写入语言键，未产生玩法进度。关键阻塞原因：resources bundle 的索引文件 assets/resources/index.09dce.js 几乎为空（只注册了一个空模块），导致 Cocos assetManager 无法从 resources bundle 中加载 Config/config、语言包、UI 预制体等关键资源；Launder.load 中的 Promise.all 因资源加载回调无法完成而挂起，Splash.start → Launder → App → enterGame 的自动加载链中断。外部请求 dssp.stnts.com 被拦截，但从源码看它只是数据上报/分析，不是进入主菜单的必经路径；真正的阻断是 resources bundle 及大量 native 资源缺失。该问题超出宿主层（index.html / local-host.js）可修复范围，无法通过注入进度或伪造资源来通过验证，因此标记为资源缺失阻断。

attempts.diagnosis: 离线检查被宿主入口中的四个 Rosebud 外部脚本阻塞；游戏主菜单已经绘制，但没有实际玩法验证。现有调用证据支持在离线宿主中移除这四个脚本标签，保留原游戏代码和宿主消息、音量接口。
attempts.hypothesis: 四个外部脚本不是菜单及核心玩法启动的必要依赖：离线阻断它们时主菜单仍能绘制；main.js 对 ProgressLogger 的调用有存在性检查，另外三个名称的全文搜索无命中。这不能排除动态依赖，须通过移除标签后的离线启动、进入关卡及实际操作证伪。

evidence.detail: passed=false；四个外部脚本 GET 被阻断；errors、missing 均为空；canvasCount=1、loaded=true；actions=[]、replay_action_count=0，尚未验证玩法。
直接通过 module 加载 main.js，并包含四个被阻断的外部 script 标签；画布为 canvas#game。
开头直接使用 Canvas 2D 并加载本地 assets；约 offset 125000 的进度上报为 if (window.ProgressLogger) window.ProgressLogger.logProgress(...)，允许接口不存在。全文搜索 ChatManager、OGP、ScriptsLoader 均为零命中；该结果不排除动态引用。
字体 CSS、字体、main.js 和图片已有本地采集记录；external 恰为上述四个脚本。已列出的 files 中未见 TRACKS 所引用的 MP3，因此进入关卡后还需检查延迟音频请求，不能以当前 missing=[] 认定资源全部闭合。
失败原因明确为 Offline check failed 的 external 列表，而非临时网络或浏览器故障。

attempts.reason: 提交完整 index.html，仅移除四个已被离线阻断的外部脚本标签；保留原宿主桥接逻辑、本地字体引用、输入默认脚本、画布与 main.js 模块入口。不创建虚假接口或上报结果，也不修改原游戏。
attempts.next_action: 由原节点应用补丁并重新执行离线检查，确认四个外部请求消失且宿主音量与消息接口仍正常；按截图中的 Enter、Space 或点击开始进入第一关，检查真实画面变化、移动、射击、暂停及恢复，并采集音频等延迟资源请求。若出现缺失 MP3 或动态接口错误，保留具体 URL、错误和截图继续分析；在实际复验通过前不宣称修复成功。

ai_analysis.summary: Cocos2d-js (Cocos Creator 2.x) web build. Startup reached the main scene; observed a title screen with Chinese text '吃豆子' and a '开始游戏' button. No runtime JS errors, no missing assets, no external network calls, and storage is isolated/empty. A mini-game SDK patch neutralizes ad/login/reward behavior for localhost. No gameplay loop was exercised, so completeness is not proven.

editable_logic.boundaries: Logic is bundled/minified in cocos2d-js-min.e0461.js and import JSONs; scene graphs and asset UUIDs are machine-generated. Direct source editing requires Cocos Creator project or JS deobfuscation. CSS and host-specific SDK patches can be edited without rebuilding the engine.

portable_modules: resource asset bundle (assets/resources/* including PNG, MP3, OGG)

dependencies.storage: isolated-page-web-storage only; no localStorage/IndexedDB data required for startup
dependencies.sdk: mini-game-sdk stubbed/patched; rewarded ads explicitly fail, login/rewards disabled

verification_limits: Only the startup/main menu scene was observed; gameplay scene not loaded.
No user actions or replay actions executed; btn_start and btn_setting handlers not triggered.
Asset completeness verified by presence and no preload errors, but in-game usage of most resource assets was not observed.
Storage is empty; save/load behavior and progress persistence could not be verified.
Audio playback, input latency, and animation loops were not tested.
Patch impact on non-localhost platform behavior is not guaranteed.
Runtime origin is a synthetic replica (replica-runtime.invalid); behavior may differ on real host/domain.
next_checks: Trigger onPlayButtonClick to enter the gameplay scene and confirm game loop loads without errors.
Trigger onOptionsButtonClick and verify settings UI responds.
Exercise core controls/inputs and observe whether gameplay matches the '吃豆子' (bean-eating) mechanic.
Monitor for runtime errors, missing asset requests, and audio decode failures during gameplay.
Test a complete level/session and check if storage writes occur (localStorage/IndexedDB) and whether the mini-game SDK patch prevents unwanted external calls.
Validate on a real deployment origin, not only the replica runtime, to confirm CORS/CSP/resource path behavior.
Compare asset manifests against source project to ensure no engine-version mismatch or corrupted bundles.

ai_analysis.summary: A Flash game (hunl2zw.swf) packaged with Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 (ruffle.js, core JS, WASM). Two patches redirect the portal loading UI to a standalone local player and enforce a local-only resource policy. The runtime reports loaded=true and playerState=2 with no runtime errors, missing assets, external requests, or blocked navigation. However, canvasCount=0, buttons/labels arrays are empty, and no replay actions were performed. WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings appear but do not stop initialization. This is evidence of successful engine/ asset startup, not proof of playable gameplay.

can_edit: index.html host wrapper and Ruffle player configuration (autoplay, scale, wmode, quality, base URL, context menu, allowNetworking)
loader/branding UI that replaces the original portal frame
local-content policy filters (what local files may be loaded, analytics/tracking removal)
file paths and packaging layout as long as relative references remain valid
isolated storage scope settings and service-worker behavior
SWF replacement only by overwriting hunl2zw.swf with a binary-compatible asset
cannot_edit_without_reverse_engineering: original hunl2zw.swf internal ActionScript, symbols, or timeline logic
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: The current package is a wrapper-level port. Modification must stay within the host page, config, local policy, and asset substitution. Recompiling the emulator core or altering SWF internals is outside the licensed/verified boundary. The game must continue to load local-only resources and must not be repackaged as a different title.

dependencies: Browser or runtime with WebAssembly and WebGL 2 support
Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 build matching the bundled JS/WASM
Correct MIME types for .wasm (application/wasm) and .swf (application/x-shockwave-flash or application/octet-stream)
Local file or static HTTP origin (origin spoofed as https://replica-runtime.invalid in the observed runtime)
Optional: localStorage/sessionStorage permission if the SWF uses SharedObject
No observed external dependencies; original analytics/ads/nav portals are explicitly excluded by local-content policy
verification_limits: Runtime 'passed' only confirms the engine initialized and the SWF reached playerState=2; it does not confirm interactive gameplay
canvasCount=0 and empty buttons/labels arrays mean no HTML-level interactive elements were detected; this may be an instrumentation gap or the SWF stage may not be exposed as a <canvas> element
Only one startup screenshot is referenced; no post-intro, menu, in-game, or save/load screenshots
No replay actions were executed, so input response, scoring, progression, and win/loss states are unverified
WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings indicate the wgpu-webgl renderer may differ from native Flash/Adobe player rendering
Storage snapshot is read-only and isolated; it cannot prove that game progress loads or persists correctly
The index.html hash changed, but the actual patch diff is not provided, so the exact host behavior cannot be audited
Runtime origin is a synthetic invalid URL; results may not transfer to a real deployment domain
next_checks: Execute scripted replay actions (keyboard/mouse) and assert visible state changes or score/level changes
Capture screenshots beyond startup: title screen, main menu, first interactive frame, and after a save/load cycle
Inspect SWF metadata (dimensions, ActionScript version, frame rate, symbols) and compare file hash to a known original
Verify whether canvasCount=0 is a measurement bug by checking the actual DOM for Ruffle's stage container
Test audio playback and mute behavior
Test local save/load by writing a SharedObject/localStorage value and reloading the page
Run with browser devtools network logging to confirm zero external requests under local-content policy
Review the exact index.html patch diff to ensure no unintended redirects or scripts were added
Test on multiple browsers/operating systems to validate WebGL compatibility and input handling
Profile frame timing to ensure the WebGL warnings do not cause stalls during gameplay

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。
二次开发边界: 当前可确认的包级边界是所列静态 HTML、JavaScript 供应库和音频资源。若 index.html 中包含可读的应用代码，可在核实脚本结构后修改；目前不能确认这一点。
vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。
清单含多个名称或版本不同的 Three.js 文件。未检查加载顺序和模块依赖前，不应假定它们都被使用，也不应随意删除或替换。
所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

ai_analysis.summary: 所供记录表明，当前 Monkey Mart 包采用 Defold WebAssembly 运行结构，已完成启动与加载阶段检查：calledRun=true、loaded=true、加载进度到达 1，未报告运行错误或缺失文件。这不等于完整玩法验收。此次仅分析提供的文本，未执行修复或验证；材料仅列出截图路径，未附可直接审阅的截图图像。

editable_logic.boundary: 当前材料是运行发布包，未提供可确认的 Defold 源工程或可编辑玩法脚本。不能据此承诺直接修改经营规则、角色行为、关卡或经济系统。
editable_logic.integration_layer: dmloader.js、MonkeyMart_wasm.js、GameAnalytics.js 及加载图片属于可进一步检查的入口、宿主集成和展示层候选；文件内容未提供，具体修改点尚不能确认。生成的引擎胶水代码修改也需要兼容性验证。
editable_logic.existing_patch: 记录声明已有 poki-offline 补丁，使用原 SDK 拒绝分支，广告与奖励不可用，并提供了修改前后哈希。宿主事件出现 init-unavailable 和 loading-finished，与该描述一致，但没有补丁源码或差异可供审查，也没有广告、奖励分支的实际交互证据。
editable_logic.core_changes: 深层玩法二次开发通常需要对应源工程及构建环境。resources.zip 的内容未知，不能将其认定为完整源码。

portable_modules.scope: MonkeyMart.wasm、对应 JavaScript 胶水、编译项目配置、archive 清单及资源分片应作为匹配的整体保留；现有证据不支持将其拆成独立玩法模块。
加载背景和进度条图片可作为展示资源候选，替换前需核对加载器引用、尺寸及使用权限。
Poki 离线适配和 GameAnalytics 集成可作为宿主迁移的检查对象；尚无证据证明它们已与核心玩法完全解耦。

dependencies.local: 文件列表包含 Defold/WASM 启动所需的候选引擎、编译配置、资源索引、数据分片和清单；所供启动记录未报告缺失项。浏览器记录包含一个 canvas 和 WebGL 诊断。
dependencies.external: 记录中的 GameAnalytics 远程配置、事件接口及 leveldata.poki.io/stores 请求均被阻断，required_external 为空。这只说明本次启动观测未发现必需外部请求，不能推断所有玩法都可离线完成。
dependencies.storage: 观察到 monkeymart_config、统计相关 localStorage 条目和 /data IndexedDB 目录记录；存储摘要不能证明进度已读取或成功保存，IndexedDB 采样不完整。
dependencies.rights: 材料未提供源码、资源或再发布许可信息，不能由文件存在推定修改及分发授权。

verification_limits: actions 为空且 replay_action_count=0，没有移动、采集、补货、售卖、升级等实际玩法断言。
runtime.passed=true 仅能支持所记录的启动检查通过，不能代表用户要求全部完成。

next_checks: 审查实际入口、加载配置及补丁差异，核对现有前后哈希并保留原包基线。
检查 resources.zip 是否包含源工程、脚本及构建配置，确定玩法二次开发的真实边界。
取得实际启动截图并检查可见画面，再通过真实交互验证移动、采集、补货、售卖及升级流程，记录操作与结果断言。

通过产生可辨认进度、刷新及重新打开页面验证存档读写，区分配置、统计队列和游戏进度。
继续观测后续资源与联网请求，验证外部服务被阻断时的玩法行为；检查实际设备上的性能。

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。
二次开发边界: 当前可确认的包级边界是所列静态 HTML、JavaScript 供应库和音频资源。若 index.html 中包含可读的应用代码，可在核实脚本结构后修改；目前不能确认这一点。
vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。
清单含多个名称或版本不同的 Three.js 文件。未检查加载顺序和模块依赖前，不应假定它们都被使用，也不应随意删除或替换。
所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

ai_analysis.summary: Cocos2d-js (Cocos Creator 2.x) web build. Startup reached the main scene; observed a title screen with Chinese text '吃豆子' and a '开始游戏' button. No runtime JS errors, no missing assets, no external network calls, and storage is isolated/empty. A mini-game SDK patch neutralizes ad/login/reward behavior for localhost. No gameplay loop was exercised, so completeness is not proven.

editable_logic.boundaries: Logic is bundled/minified in cocos2d-js-min.e0461.js and import JSONs; scene graphs and asset UUIDs are machine-generated. Direct source editing requires Cocos Creator project or JS deobfuscation. CSS and host-specific SDK patches can be edited without rebuilding the engine.

portable_modules: resource asset bundle (assets/resources/* including PNG, MP3, OGG)

dependencies.storage: isolated-page-web-storage only; no localStorage/IndexedDB data required for startup
dependencies.sdk: mini-game-sdk stubbed/patched; rewarded ads explicitly fail, login/rewards disabled

verification_limits: Only the startup/main menu scene was observed; gameplay scene not loaded.
No user actions or replay actions executed; btn_start and btn_setting handlers not triggered.
Asset completeness verified by presence and no preload errors, but in-game usage of most resource assets was not observed.
Storage is empty; save/load behavior and progress persistence could not be verified.
Audio playback, input latency, and animation loops were not tested.
Patch impact on non-localhost platform behavior is not guaranteed.
Runtime origin is a synthetic replica (replica-runtime.invalid); behavior may differ on real host/domain.
next_checks: Trigger onPlayButtonClick to enter the gameplay scene and confirm game loop loads without errors.
Trigger onOptionsButtonClick and verify settings UI responds.
Exercise core controls/inputs and observe whether gameplay matches the '吃豆子' (bean-eating) mechanic.
Monitor for runtime errors, missing asset requests, and audio decode failures during gameplay.
Test a complete level/session and check if storage writes occur (localStorage/IndexedDB) and whether the mini-game SDK patch prevents unwanted external calls.
Validate on a real deployment origin, not only the replica runtime, to confirm CORS/CSP/resource path behavior.
Compare asset manifests against source project to ensure no engine-version mismatch or corrupted bundles.

game_profile.perspective: 俯视
game_profile.core_gameplay: 操控吃豆人在迷宫中沿道路移动，吃掉全部豆子并躲避或利用道具反制鬼魂敌人，达成通关或耗尽生命后结算。
game_profile.core_experience: 经典街机式吃豆子体验，强调即时反应、路径规划与风险躲避。
game_profile.controls: 键盘方向键（或虚拟摇杆）控制移动方向；设置面板可调整音乐、音效、移动速度。
game_profile.game_loop: 进入主菜单→点击开始游戏加载当前关卡→操控角色收集豆子→触碰敌人损失生命或触发失败→通关/失败后弹出结算对话框→返回主菜单或重试。
game_profile.content: 迷宫关卡、可收集豆子、特殊道具（生命/无敌）、鬼魂敌人、HUD、设置与结算弹窗。未验证具体关卡总数。
game_profile.progression: 通过 localStorage 的 'pac' 键记录已通关数，通关后递增并加载下一关（代码中 mod 10 循环）；设置项持久化到 localStorage。
game_profile.save: 本地 localStorage 加密存储（XXTEA 算法，键前缀 10192_），保存设置（音乐、音效、速度、音量）与关卡进度；本次已验证设置项在刷新后保留。

ai_analysis.summary: 所给记录支持的结论是：一个 Three.js 网页包在一次启动检查中加载成功，显示了游戏启动界面和控制提示。记录报告无运行错误、缺失文件或外部请求，且有一张启动截图；但没有执行任何游戏操作，也没有回放动作。因此目前只能评价为启动级检查通过，不能据此声称玩法移植或完整验收通过。

现有证据: 清单包含 index.html，但未提供其源码、脚本关系或独立的游戏逻辑文件，无法确认玩法代码具体位置。
清单报告 index.html 和多个 vendor 文件有 local-static-references 类型的修改，并列出修改前后哈希；没有差异内容，无法判断修改范围是否仅限引用路径。
没有证据表明关卡、敌人、碰撞、得分、生命值、武器、结算或存档逻辑已被定位、修改或验证。
二次开发边界: 当前可确认的包级边界是所列静态 HTML、JavaScript 供应库和音频资源。若 index.html 中包含可读的应用代码，可在核实脚本结构后修改；目前不能确认这一点。
vendor 中的 Three.js、GLTFLoader 和 SkeletonUtils 应先视为第三方依赖，不宜在缺少源码差异与版本确认时直接改动其内部实现。
清单含多个名称或版本不同的 Three.js 文件。未检查加载顺序和模块依赖前，不应假定它们都被使用，也不应随意删除或替换。
所给材料中的权利归属或抽取许可陈述不能由运行包本身证实；衍生发布权限仍需单独核实。

portable_modules.portability: 可作为候选渲染依赖随静态包部署；实际使用的文件、版本和互相依赖关系尚未确认。

portable_modules.evidence: 清单列出对应脚本。

portable_modules.evidence: 清单列出 14 个 WAV 文件，名称涵盖音乐、攻击、受击和效果音。
portable_modules.portability: 文件可随静态资源包携带；触发时机、音量混合、浏览器自动播放限制处理及关卡间管理均未验证。

portable_modules.evidence: 启动运行文本显示分数、生命、武器、炸弹、控制提示及启动、指南相关界面文字。
portable_modules.portability: 可确认这些文字在启动检查中出现，不能据此确认对应按钮、HUD 更新或交互逻辑可移植且正常工作。

dependencies: 包内依赖至少包括 index.html、所列 JavaScript 文件及 WAV 资源；记录中未观察到外部网络请求，但这只覆盖该次启动路径。
运行记录报告浏览器中创建了一个 canvas，并加载了字体；WebGL 在该次运行中可启动，但兼容性和其他设备表现未验证。
页面交互依赖 DOM；图形和声音分别依赖浏览器图形与音频能力。音频资源是否能在用户手势后正常播放尚未检查。
多个 Three.js 文件可能引入版本冲突、全局变量覆盖或重复加载风险；需要依据实际脚本引用和运行时模块图确认。
存储检查仅覆盖隔离页面中的 localStorage 和 sessionStorage，二者记录为空；IndexedDB 与内存状态未检查。
verification_limits: 检查记录报告运行通过、无错误、无缺失文件、无预加载错误，且启动界面已加载；这些是所给记录的结果，并非独立复测结论。
replay_action_count 为 0，actions 为空。鼠标或键盘移动、攻击、炸弹、爆破蓄力、暂停、关卡推进、首领战、受伤、结算及重开均未验证。
页面上显示的控制提示只证明提示文字出现，不证明相应输入有效。
仅有启动截图，未提供玩法过程截图、视频、操作日志、原作对照或行为断言；不能据此判断移植忠实度或完整度。
local-static-references 修改的哈希记录不等于源码差异审查；无法据此确认修改内容、兼容性或第三方库授权状态。
运行日志出现多条 GPU stall / ReadPixels 性能提示；其影响程度和是否由测试工具导致尚不清楚。
next_checks: 取得实际解包文件树、index.html 和相关脚本源码，核对资源路径、脚本加载顺序、实际使用的 Three.js 版本，并审查所列修改的源码差异。
在可重复的浏览器会话中记录真实输入与结果，至少检查启动、移动、攻击、炸弹、爆破蓄力、暂停与恢复、受伤、关卡推进、结算和重开；为每项定义可观察的通过条件。
保存带操作过程的截图或视频、浏览器控制台与网络记录，并将实际动作计数纳入验收材料；在获得玩法断言前，不标记玩法完整验收。
若原游戏设计包含进度保存，分别检查 localStorage、sessionStorage、IndexedDB 和重新载入后的状态；若不包含，记录该项不适用的依据。
在目标浏览器及不同窗口尺寸下复测 WebGL、字体、音频、输入和性能；确认 GPU stall 日志的影响。
复核静态包的文件清单、依赖来源、资源使用权和发布许可，再确定可发布范围。

ai_analysis.summary: A Flash game (hunl2zw.swf) packaged with Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 (ruffle.js, core JS, WASM). Two patches redirect the portal loading UI to a standalone local player and enforce a local-only resource policy. The runtime reports loaded=true and playerState=2 with no runtime errors, missing assets, external requests, or blocked navigation. However, canvasCount=0, buttons/labels arrays are empty, and no replay actions were performed. WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings appear but do not stop initialization. This is evidence of successful engine/ asset startup, not proof of playable gameplay.

can_edit: index.html host wrapper and Ruffle player configuration (autoplay, scale, wmode, quality, base URL, context menu, allowNetworking)
loader/branding UI that replaces the original portal frame
local-content policy filters (what local files may be loaded, analytics/tracking removal)
file paths and packaging layout as long as relative references remain valid
isolated storage scope settings and service-worker behavior
SWF replacement only by overwriting hunl2zw.swf with a binary-compatible asset
cannot_edit_without_reverse_engineering: original hunl2zw.swf internal ActionScript, symbols, or timeline logic
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: The current package is a wrapper-level port. Modification must stay within the host page, config, local policy, and asset substitution. Recompiling the emulator core or altering SWF internals is outside the licensed/verified boundary. The game must continue to load local-only resources and must not be repackaged as a different title.

dependencies: Browser or runtime with WebAssembly and WebGL 2 support
Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 build matching the bundled JS/WASM
Correct MIME types for .wasm (application/wasm) and .swf (application/x-shockwave-flash or application/octet-stream)
Local file or static HTTP origin (origin spoofed as https://replica-runtime.invalid in the observed runtime)
Optional: localStorage/sessionStorage permission if the SWF uses SharedObject
No observed external dependencies; original analytics/ads/nav portals are explicitly excluded by local-content policy
verification_limits: Runtime 'passed' only confirms the engine initialized and the SWF reached playerState=2; it does not confirm interactive gameplay
canvasCount=0 and empty buttons/labels arrays mean no HTML-level interactive elements were detected; this may be an instrumentation gap or the SWF stage may not be exposed as a <canvas> element
Only one startup screenshot is referenced; no post-intro, menu, in-game, or save/load screenshots
No replay actions were executed, so input response, scoring, progression, and win/loss states are unverified
WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings indicate the wgpu-webgl renderer may differ from native Flash/Adobe player rendering
Storage snapshot is read-only and isolated; it cannot prove that game progress loads or persists correctly
The index.html hash changed, but the actual patch diff is not provided, so the exact host behavior cannot be audited
Runtime origin is a synthetic invalid URL; results may not transfer to a real deployment domain
next_checks: Execute scripted replay actions (keyboard/mouse) and assert visible state changes or score/level changes
Capture screenshots beyond startup: title screen, main menu, first interactive frame, and after a save/load cycle
Inspect SWF metadata (dimensions, ActionScript version, frame rate, symbols) and compare file hash to a known original
Verify whether canvasCount=0 is a measurement bug by checking the actual DOM for Ruffle's stage container
Test audio playback and mute behavior
Test local save/load by writing a SharedObject/localStorage value and reloading the page
Run with browser devtools network logging to confirm zero external requests under local-content policy
Review the exact index.html patch diff to ensure no unintended redirects or scripts were added
Test on multiple browsers/operating systems to validate WebGL compatibility and input handling
Profile frame timing to ensure the WebGL warnings do not cause stalls during gameplay

ai_analysis.summary: Runtime package renders a browser-DOM phonics activity titled 'Phonics Detectives / Digraph Detectives'. Startup passed with no errors, all listed assets loaded, no blocked external requests, and an interactive DOM with category tabs, answer tiles, audio and help controls. The current view shows a single digraph prompt ('sock' -> 'ck') but no gameplay actions were replayed. Source-analysis artifacts exist for main.js and two remote scripts via webcrack, while 'editable_project_verified' is false and Cocos/build validation is explicitly out of scope. Therefore this is evidence of a bootable UI shell, not proof of a fully verified educational game.

editable_logic.boundary: Only the shipped files in the runtime package are observable editable surfaces. The bundled game logic lives mainly in main.js and rosebud-game-defaults.js/css; remote _remote/ scripts are delivered as opaque hashed payloads.
editable_items: main.js (game state, tab routing, prompt/answer wiring)
read_only_or_external: _remote/*.js hashed modules (ScriptsLoader-Universal.js, ChatManager.js, ProgressLogger.js, ImageGenerator.js, OGP.js)
Remote .woff2 font delivered from hashed path
Browser storage APIs are observable but not guaranteed persistent across deployments
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: A derivative can safely replace main.js, default CSS/JS, and local assets; can patch index.html to change entrypoints; can wrap or stub localStorage/sessionStorage. It cannot reliably modify the internal behavior of hashed remote modules unless they are replaced with same-path equivalents and the loader hash/integrity checks (if any) are updated. Rebuilding as a Cocos/Unity-style project requires editor/build validation not present here.

verification_limits: Only the startup phase was observed (24.1 s checkpoint). No user actions or replay actions were executed.
The 'runtime passed' flag confirms DOM load and absence of runtime errors, not correct answer handling, scoring, win state, or accessibility.
Storage snapshots are empty; hashes cannot prove progress load/save behavior. IndexedDB/WASM FS are read-only snapshots, not atomic cross-store snapshots.
Source analysis is static and limited to at most 3 scripts <=1MB; Cocos/editor build validation is excluded. 'editable_project_verified' is false.
External requests were not required/blocked at startup, but generative/chat modules may call external endpoints during gameplay; that behavior is unverified.
The asset list shows content for the first prompt only ('sock' / 'ck'); coverage of the claimed 24 words is not evidenced.
Viewport coordinates and button labels are from a 1000x760 software-rendered Chromium snapshot; layout may differ on other viewports or with different font metrics.
Adblockers reported zero blocks at startup; they do not intercept gameplay logic, cosmetic injection, or SDK spoofing.

Trigger 'Hear the clue' and validate audio playback under user-gesture policy.
Click reset/journey/help/mute and verify state changes without runtime errors.
Inspect localStorage/sessionStorage after progress events to confirm persistence contract.
Audit remaining remote scripts (ProgressLogger.js, ImageGenerator.js, OGP.js) and any network calls they may make during play.
Verify all 24 word assets are present and referenced, not just the first prompt.
Run responsive/accessibility checks at common viewports and with keyboard-only input.
If Cocos/Unity build output is claimed, validate it against an editor project rather than relying on runtime artifacts alone.

ai_analysis.summary: Partial inventory of a Cocos Creator 2.x HTML5 web build. It contains a minified Cocos2d-JS runtime (cocos2d-js-min.40b98.js), bootstrap/setting scripts (main.0f99b.js, src/settings.801e6.js), mobile CSS, and several asset bundles: internal, main, resources, bundleMap_1/2/3, and bundleAudios. Assets are stored by UUID under each bundle's import/ and native/ folders, with JSON metadata + PNG/JPG/MP3 resources. A single remote asset is referenced at _remote/91d4a19849c304ed/landscape.gif. No source project, no index.html, and no runtime logs are present in the provided material, so this is only a packaging/portability evidence review.

easily_editable: src/settings.801e6.js (launch config, bundle registration, device flags)
Bundle config.json files (assets/*/config.*.json) for bundle names, versions, and asset lists
Bundle import/*.json metadata (UUID, type, dependencies, native file references)
Native assets (PNG/JPG/MP3/GIF) can be replaced if UUID metadata references are updated consistently
hard_to_edit: main.0f99b.js and all bundle index.*.js are minified/obfuscated; source-level logic changes require deobfuscation/patching
cocos2d-js-min.40b98.js is the engine runtime; should be treated as read-only unless replacing the entire engine version
editable_logic.notes: Game logic is likely compiled into the minified index.js files inside each bundle. Secondary development is therefore limited to asset swapping, config tuning, and byte-level JS patching; behavioral changes require reverse-engineering or a rebuilt project.

portable_modules.bundle_strategy: Map and audio bundles are split, supporting on-demand loading; portable if the host keeps relative paths and serves bundle configs correctly.

dependencies.browser_apis: Canvas/WebGL, AudioContext/HTMLAudio, touch/mouse events, localStorage (typical Cocos settings)
dependencies.external_asset: _remote/91d4a19849c304ed/landscape.gif must be reachable at runtime (network or mirrored path)
dependencies.path_dependencies: UUID-based folder structure and config.*.json/index.*.js must remain paired and relative paths unchanged
no_evidence_of: obvious third-party analytics or SDK files (cannot confirm absence from inventory alone)

cannot_verify: Actual gameplay correctness or feature completeness
Whether the provided file list is complete (list is truncated and lacks index.html/server config)
No real runtime testing has been performed
No deobfuscated source, so no behavioral assertions are possible
No version/build metadata to identify Cocos Creator exact version
verification_limits.boundary: This is a runtime web package, not an editable source project. Any secondary development must work within the compiled bundle structure and minified scripts.

Serve the package on a local HTTP host and capture browser console/network errors
Verify each config.*.json lists the same number of import/native entries as the actual files on disk

report.summary: 本轮已执行的动作（reload、点击“免费试用”、点击遮罩）在运行时层面产生了可辨识反馈：节点树从“试用超酷球杆进行游戏”提示推进到“滑动调整方向瞄准球洞”提示，可点击按钮集合相应变化；localStorage 中 user1/other1 的长度与哈希在 reload 前后发生变化，说明游戏正在读写本地存档。runtime 未报告 HTTP 外部请求、未报告报错，`r is not defined` 已被 local-host.js 中的 StageBannerMgr 离线补丁屏蔽。然而所有平台截图均为空白，无法确认实际渲染画面（球台、球杆、球体）是否可见，也无法确认滑动击球的核心玩法视觉闭环。因此依赖项只能按“交互状态可用、视觉未验证”的范围更新，无法完成全量玩法验证。

dependency_updates.reason: 新手引导场景（game_newbie/gameScene、pool_stage、cueTrialLayer）及 UI 资源已实际加载，runtime 无 missing/报错；未游玩关卡、商城等后续资源不在本验证范围。
关卡配置已生效：level_node 标签显示“1”，动态场景 game_newbie 正确实例化；仅验证到第 1 关/新手引导配置。
已验证的新手引导流程未产生任何外部 HTTP 请求；存档读写发生在 localStorage（user1/other1/localData），reload 后数据保持且内容变化。结算、广告、排行榜等后端接口未在此流程触发，故对当前验证终点不适用。

game_profile.save: localStorage（键 user1 / other1 / localData），跨 reload 可保留

blocker.reason: 运行时节点树和存储变化证明游戏逻辑与本地存档正常工作，但平台截图持续空白，无法验证实际渲染画面及击球视觉反馈。该阻断不是代码报错或资源缺失，而是渲染/截图捕获层面的不可见。
blocker.next_action: 平台侧确认当前 WebGL/software 渲染环境是否支持截图捕获（如 preserveDrawingBuffer、画布合成模式），或提供可读取渲染像素/节点可见性的诊断接口；在视觉可验证前，不能将核心玩法标为已验证。

ai_analysis.summary: 该包为 Cocos Creator 导出的 Web（HTML5）构建产物，包含 cocos-js 引擎、system 加载器、import-map、settings、main/resources/internal 资源包以及 Physics/Spine 等 WASM/ASM 模块。运行时能够在隔离浏览器环境中启动，创建 1 个 WebGL canvas，未触发脚本报错，引擎与主资源已加载；但当前只捕获到启动瞬间截图，未观察到按钮、标签、可点击入口或实际玩法画面，无法确认游戏入口是否可达。外部广告 SDK 端点 https://dssp.stnts.com/ 的请求被阻断，且已被标注为本地宿主/激励广告显式失败，不生成伪造登录或奖励。多个装饰性图片缺失，按用户要求不再阻断转换，但需验证是否影响首屏渲染。

editable_logic.description: 当前为已编译的发布包，核心逻辑以压缩/混淆后的 bundle JS 与 JSON 配置形式存在，可直接修改的范围受限于运行时加载体系。
modifiable: assets/main/config.185d1.json 与 index.185d1.js：主场景包配置与脚本，可替换场景、预制体引用或注入调试日志。
assets/resources/config.09dce.json 与 index.09dce.js：资源包配置与脚本，可调整动态资源路径、分包策略。
assets/Scripts/config.11e73.json 与 index.11e73.js：业务脚本入口，可修改初始化、事件注册、平台桥接逻辑。
src/settings.a4720.json：引擎启动参数（渲染后端、物理引擎、适配策略等）。
src/import-map.31c03.json 与 src/chunks/bundle.fc9a0.js：模块映射与 chunk，可重定向模块加载。
style.css：页面样式、canvas 容器、loading 遮罩。
src/assets/Scripts/Plugins/Plugin.629b4.js：插件脚本，可替换或打补丁。
缺失装饰性资源的 404 fallback 与路径映射。
frozen: cocos-js/cc.5440a.js 与 _virtual_cc-ca659014.js 等引擎核心文件：修改需对应引擎源码重新构建，否则易出现 ABI/版本不一致。
WASM 二进制（bullet/spine/meshopt）及 ASM 回退：只能整体替换对应版本编译产物，不能直接改内部逻辑。
system.bundle / polyfills：运行时加载器，通常保持原样。
editable_logic.boundary: 二次开发边界在于：可在 Cocos 资源/脚本/配置层做运行时补丁与资源替换，也可针对小游戏平台补充平台桥接（登录、广告、支付）的 stub；但若要改动引擎渲染、物理、Spine 运行时行为，必须回到原始 Cocos Creator 工程重新导出，否则风险不可控。当前包未附带 source map，调试与修改成本较高。

portable_modules.note: 包含渲染、组件系统、资源管理，目标平台需支持 WebGL/WebGL2。
含场景配置与若干图片资源，需确认入口场景在目标平台正常加载。
含动态加载的 cconb/json/png 等，部分装饰性资源缺失需补齐或屏蔽引用。
业务逻辑入口，可能包含平台相关代码，需要移植时替换为平台适配层。
bullet（wasm/asm）、spine（wasm/asm/js）、meshopt_decoder（wasm/asm），目标平台需支持对应二进制格式或启用 JS 回退。

portable_modules.module: 小游戏 SDK 桥接补丁
portable_modules.note: 已存在 mini-game-sdk 补丁，奖励广告显式失败；可移植时扩展为各平台统一 API。

dependencies: 浏览器环境：WebGL canvas、requestAnimationFrame、fetch/XMLHttpRequest、localStorage/sessionStorage。
广告/数据上报：运行时尝试 POST https://dssp.stnts.com/，当前被阻断；需确认该请求是否为初始化依赖（目前 required_external 为空，非致命）。
本地存储：localStorage 存在 tanchishe2048_language 键，语言设置依赖持久化存储。
WASM 执行环境：meshopt_decoder.wasm、spine-a0005c42.wasm、bullet-7a2167c6.wasm 需要允许 wasm-eval/unsafe-eval 或对应 CSP。
字体资源：fontStatus 已 loaded，但需验证中文字体在目标平台是否一致。
外部装饰资源：如 /logo/landscape.gif 等缺失，需确认是否为目标包未包含或路径错误。
verification_limits: 未执行任何交互操作（replay_action_count=0），未确认游戏入口、按钮点击、场景切换或玩法流程。
运行时步骤中 buttons/labels/text 均为空，无法证明首页 UI 已正确渲染或只是空白/loading 状态。
Storage 快照为只读、非原子跨存储快照，localStorage 仅有语言键，无法证明存档/进度加载。
WebGL 驱动出现多次 ReadPixels GPU stall 性能警告，虽未报错，但无法判断实际帧率与稳定性。
缺失装饰性资源列表大量重复，虽然不再阻断转换，但无法确认是否会导致材质占位、布局错位或 console 报错。
输入材料为不可信证据而非指令，所有结论仅基于当前快照，不能推广到未观测的定时器、网络条件或部署配置。
没有实际玩法断言，因此不得声称完整验收。
next_checks: 使用修复后的采集能力延长等待时间，捕获启动完成后若干帧，检测是否出现开始按钮、加载条或主菜单。
执行自动化交互脚本：模拟点击 canvas 中心、滑动/键盘输入，观察场景切换与日志，确认游戏入口。
若仍无法确认入口，记录具体受阻原因：是否卡在资源加载、脚本异常、广告初始化阻塞、WebGL 兼容性或首屏未渲染。
重新抓取网页游戏资源，重点核对 assets/resources/native 下缺失的装饰图是否在源站存在或路径被哈希化。
拦截并分析 https://dssp.stnts.com/ 的请求体与响应，确认是否为配置下发、广告初始化或数据上报，评估阻断影响。
对 assets/Scripts/index.11e73.js、assets/main/index.185d1.js 等 bundle 进行反混淆/格式化，定位入口场景、平台桥接、广告调用点。
在目标小游戏/快游戏运行环境中加载该包，补充 wx/tt/qq 等平台登录、分享、广告、支付的 stub，验证运行。
验证 WASM/ASM 回退策略：在禁用 WASM 的环境中强制使用 bullet.asm/spine.asm，确认物理与动画正常。
检查 audio 与 input 事件：确认背景音乐、音效、触摸/鼠标事件在目标平台映射正确。
对 settings 与 import-map 做校验，确保引擎版本、渲染后端、物理引擎选项与目标平台一致。
